scope: Two complete May static text helpers on three RU platforms: native/raw/optimized showText and getLineNumbers. The showText height traversal and its discarded results precede painting in all current artifacts. Complete instructions/handlers and all actual callers remain recorded, without deleting local slots, branches or ABI differences. Native retains an unused font-size argument; modern optimization removes it. The generic raw helpers keep their inherited arguments; no equivalence for arbitrary parameters outside actual native callers is claimed. Structural checks alone do not establish runtime or whole-program equivalence.
